title: Systems and methods for die-to-database alignment and defect inspection in electron beam systems
core_idea: Uses hierarchical coarse-to-fine alignment: coarse optical/SEM alignment followed by localized fine patch correlation with stage drift compensation
failure_case_noted: Repetitive pattern cell confusion when FOV lacks unique alignment fiducials
smart_sem_adaptation: Directly integrated as our Coarse-to-Fine Scale-Aware Matching + Navigation Drift Simulator

title: Method and apparatus for stage error compensation during semiconductor inspection
core_idea: Models mechanical stage hysteresis, backlash, and laser interferometer drift over multi-step raster scan paths
failure_case_noted: Uncompensated cumulative stage thermal expansion causing systematic coordinate offsets
smart_sem_adaptation: Directly modeled in our `NavigationErrorSimulator` (backlash, thermal rate, drift)

title: Method of SEM image alignment for periodic structures using phase information
core_idea: Extracts 2D Fourier phase spectrum from periodic contact arrays to determine array pitch and eliminate integer-pitch alias ambiguity
failure_case_noted: Phase unwrapping errors in high shot-noise inspection regimes
smart_sem_adaptation: Implemented in `src/smart_sem/topology.py` (2D FFT pitch & orientation estimation)

title: Cross-modality wafer alignment system and method
core_idea: Aligns optical alignment marks with electron-beam metrology scans using gradient orientation histograms invariant to imaging physics
failure_case_noted: Contrast inversion and charging streak artifacts in e-beam images

title: Multi-beam SEM position determination with confusion matrix validation
core_idea: Generates similarity confidence heatmaps across multiple beam channels to detect anomalous multi-peak matches in periodic gratings
failure_case_noted: Single-threshold matchers selecting spurious noise peaks
